phases.name: Presentation
phases.content: In this unit you will learn how to form new words using prefixes, suffixes and compounding. This is essential for the Use of English paper.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.content: Read these examples. Happy - unhappy - happiness. Care - careful - careless - carelessly. Notice how the same root produces different words.

phases.name: Guided practice
phases.explanation: We need an adjective describing a person: careless.

phases.name: Free practice
phases.prompt: Take 5 words and write their noun, verb, adjective and adverb forms.

phases.name: Mini-test
phases.prompt: The ___ (decide) was very difficult to make.
phases.explanation: The noun form of decide is decision.
